{{Quote|We just have to cross this swamp. The ''enemy lines'' should be right behind those trees.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Night Moves!">{{TCWComicCite|6.27|Night Moves!}}</ref>}}
'''Zeenada''' was a [[Swamp/Legends|marshy]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] primarily covered in [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]].

==History==
Zeenada was [[Battle of Zeenada|invaded]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sent [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] forces to retake the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. The planet was soon freed from Separatist control.

==Inhabitants==
Zeenada was home to a variety of dangerous creatures, including a type of [[Feline/Legends|feline]] [[Unidentified predator|predator]] that inhabited its [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]], and a type of [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Swamp monster|creature]] that made its home in the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]].
